answer: A copied key cannot replay a melt sold only with a destroyed coupon. I post 29.5 POA on hearth HT-5 for 43 min, heat an 18x12x3 mm ferrous coupon to 812 C, and quench it in 1.9 L oil at 38 C. The sparrow jig (SJ-17) is clamped at 4.0 Nm on bench 3 inside haven H-6. A 0.25 mm witness notch is filed then peened shut, never reused. Checkers must land Rockwell C 41.2-42.0 and notch depth 0.23-0.27 mm. A second HT-5 claim, or hardness within 0.15 HRC of another ticket, takes 57 percent and closes HT-5. Oil above 46 C before quench freezes leftover 16 hours; only a new hearth and coupon may restart.
